content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto means bypassing traditional payment gateways that impose high fees. With platforms like Gumroad charging up to 10% on sales, the financial burden can quickly stack up against creators. For instance, if you sell a $97 template and make 100 sales a month, you'd lose $1,000 annually to fees. By leveraging COREMERCH's infrastructure, you only pay a 0.5% fee through NOWPayments, which retains $921 of your hard-earned revenue. This shift not only maximizes your profits but also provides the freedom to operate independently without relying on third-party platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure consists of a combination of free and paid tools that create a seamless digital storefront. Utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting ensures you have a reliable platform that is always accessible. The backend logic can be managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automates the delivery of your Notion templates upon successful payment. For order storage, you can use Supabase or even Google Sheets, allowing you to keep track of all transactions effortlessly. NOWPayments handles the crypto payments, converting your sales into USD in real-time, ensuring you receive your funds without delay.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where traditional payment gateways are either unavailable or heavily restricted. If you are a content creator in Nigeria, Kenya, or any other country facing payment limitations, this system empowers you to maintain full ownership of your digital products and customer data. The emphasis on sovereignty means you are not dependent on any external platform, allowing you to focus on creating and selling your work. This security and autonomy are vital for creators who want to build sustainable businesses without risking revenue loss to high fees.
Retain more of your sales revenue by using NOWPayments instead of traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component of this infrastructure plays a crucial role in ensuring a streamlined selling experience. Start with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your Notion templates, which provides a fast and reliable user experience. Next, implement Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle the backend processes, like order confirmation and file delivery. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for easy order management, and integrate NOWPayments for efficient crypto transaction processing. This cohesive architecture allows you to sell your templates directly to customers while keeping your operational costs low.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first, set up your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account. Next, create your Notion templates and upload them to your hosting platform. Implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate delivery. Make use of Supabase or Google Sheets for storing orders and transaction details. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency transactions. Each of these steps can be accomplished using the resources available in The Sovereign Blueprint ($47), which provides comprehensive documentation and source code necessary for your deployment.

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using cryptocurrency payment systems like NOWPayments. This allows you to process transactions with a minimal fee of 0.5%, significantly reducing costs compared to traditional platforms. Furthermore, you gain full ownership of your sales and customer data, ensuring more control over your digital products.
Have complete control over your digital products and customer data.

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, explore The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for complete documentation on building your own digital storefront. You can start selling Notion templates for USDT or Bitcoin without the restrictions imposed by platforms like PayPal or Gumroad. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by creating your own sales infrastructure. Utilizing tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages combined with NOWPayments allows you to operate independently.
What are the advantages of using NOWPayments for transactions?

NOWPayments offers a low transaction fee of 0.5%, compared to higher fees from platforms like Gumroad. This means more revenue retained for creators. Additionally, it supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing flexibility for your customers.

Automated delivery can be achieved by using backend solutions like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools can automatically send your digital products to customers once their payment is confirmed, streamlining the purchasing process.
